name: Innova Captab Limited
summary: Innova Captab Limited, an integrated pharmaceutical company, engages in the research and development, manufacture, distribution, and marketing of drugs and pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. The company provides contract development and manufacturing organization services to Indian pharmaceutical companies.
